1.explanation: The 'src/menu/index.jsx' and 'src/menu/view/item.jsx' files are directly related to the rendering of Menu Items, where the title attribute is being set. These files would need to be modified to implement the proposed solutions regarding how the title is handled based on the inner text. The 'src/config-provider/config.jsx' file is relevant because it would need to contain the configuration API (showTitle) that controls whether the title should be shown based on user preference.
1.bug_scenario: The title attribute is currently added to Menu Items, causing issues when the title matches the inner text, resulting in potential accessibility violations as per WCAG guidelines. Users are experiencing unwanted tooltip displays when they hover over Menu Items that contain titles identical to their inner text. The proposed solutions include modifying the title to an aria-label for certain cases or providing a configuration option to control title display.
